A special turn ahead, a clear notice
The subject is traveler questions
Plain notice for companion travel

Travelers need to know that pet support at Aurelia Skyways is kept calm, careful, and clear before departure. Please read every desk update closely so you and your animal are ready. We are sorry when plans feel rushed, and we try to keep the steps simple.

For arrivals and transfers, staff record changes in the ledger and guide people with plain words. Please follow the signs, keep carriers secure, and speak up early if your pet needs extra help. <<FACT F016>>.

If your trip includes a hold check or a room review, the team will explain the process at the desk and note any needed service change. <<FACT F030>> We appreciate your patience and want every companion to travel safely.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
